programs.title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case for the Winemaker
programs.desc: Former criminologist Ainsley McGregor returns to her hometown of Sweet River, Texas, to open a market for artisans to sell crafts and wares. However, when her friend is accused of murder, McGregor finds herself returning to her crime-solving ways.

programs.title: Picture Perfect Romance
programs.desc: Zoey Ross gave up on love and her passion for wedding photography after her fiancé, Todd, left her at the altar five years ago. When a childhood friend insists that she be their wedding photographer, she reluctantly accepts and finds herself again.

programs.title: The Perfect Man(icure)
programs.desc: Quirky inventor Katya partners with charismatic marketing consultant Ryan to help sell her personal manicure device, Phenomenails, at the upcoming beauty expo.

programs.title: The Story of Love
programs.desc: Ruby, an aspiring romance novelist, joins a writers retreat in Tahoe to win a book deal. However, when Woody, the outdoorsy hotel owner, shows her nature's beauty, she reevaluates her choices.

programs.title: Morning Show Mysteries: Murder Ever After
programs.desc: TV host Billie Blessings finds bones in the basement of an old friend's house, unearthing a dark secret that threatens to unravel the lives of the most powerful people in the city.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: Search & Seized
programs.desc: Every year, Jennifer and her friend Miles Wexford participate in the organization of an auction of goods seized by the police. The night of the auction, Miles is found dead in his store. Every clue points to suicide, but there is more to it. Jennifer learns that he was in serious debt due to a gambling problem.
